description: The shapes tools/compiler-fixtures/portable-host-facts.c records, with the Portable declaration and values that produce the same object, and the BitfieldPacking mode(s) in which the library reproduces a compiler of the matching ABI family byte for byte. CompilerDifferentialFixtureTests verifies every claim against every baseline; compiler-fixture.mjs renders the table in differences-from-c.md.

portable.layout: struct s { uint8 a:3; uint8 b:5; uint16 c; };
